title: Seceda & the Dolomites
route: Brescia → Ortisei → Seceda → Selva di Val Gardena
introTitle: Into the heart of the Dolomites.
intro: Travel from Brescia to Ortisei and ride the cableways to Seceda for the dramatic Odle ridgeline and Alpine scenery. Enjoy time on the mountain, then descend to Ortisei and drive directly to Selva di Val Gardena for a relaxing afternoon and overnight stay. The Sella Ronda mountain-pass circuit is not part of today's plan.

stops.name: Brescia
stops.description: Begin in Brescia and drive north toward Val Gardena and the Dolomites.

stops.name: Seceda Cableways — Ortisei
stops.description: Park in Ortisei and take the cableways toward Seceda.

stops.name: Seceda
stops.description: Enjoy the iconic Odle ridgeline and panoramic Alpine scenery.

stops.name: Seceda Cableways — Ortisei
stops.description: Descend by cableway to Ortisei, then return to the car for the short drive to Selva.

stops.name: Hotel Granbaita — Selva di Val Gardena
stops.description: Drive directly from Ortisei to the hotel, without the Sella Ronda mountain-pass circuit.
